chunks: Then they hamstrung the she-camel and rebelled against the command of their Lord, and said: "Bring, O Saleh, on us the affliction you promise, if you are one of the sent ones."
ai.seo_question: What did the people of Saleh say after killing the she-camel?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from mere disbelief to active rebellion, as the people of Thamud not only slaughtered the miraculous she-camel but also arrogantly challenged Prophet Saleh to hasten the divine punishment. Their demand, 'if you are of the messengers,' reveals a superficial test of prophethood rather than sincere acceptance, highlighting the consequence of defying God's clear command after the sign was presented.
